notes.title: SEASON 3: DESERT STORM
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/3b0d99ec9242c73b9ed8e3a1afcbf270027f8c7d.png[/img]

Hello to the Blockade community!

Today, the season 3 - DESERT STORM started in the game. The season will last until June 12 inclusive. This time, for the season, real-life weapons are taken as the basis, and not invented, as was the case in the first two seasons. The emphasis in season 3 is on the visual component.

For completing the DESERT STORM season you will receive: 3 exclusive skins for a character, 2 exclusive skins for vehicles, 5 weapons with a unique skin, an exclusive "DESERT STORM" badge, as well as 200 coins and a lot of ammunition.

There are 110 levels in total in the season. You can skip the first 100 levels by purchasing them with coins (150 coins per level. ELITE BATTLE PASS only). The last 10 levels are unmissable!

To receive more rewards, you need to purchase an ELITE BATTLE PASS.

HOW DOES THE ELITE BATTLE PASS WORK?
[list]
[*] Complete weekly missions to level up your Battle Pass;
[*] Get free rewards for new levels;
[*] Earn more rewards when you purchase the ELITE BATTLE PASS. Rewards are given at each level;
[*] You can purchase the ELITE BATTLE PASS at any time and you will unlock all rewards up to your current ELITE BATTLE PASS level.
[/list]

By purchasing the ELITE BATTLE PASS for 1000 coins and leveling it up, you will receive: 8 exclusive skins for character, 5 exclusive skins for vehicles, 15 weapons with a unique skins, an exclusive badge "DESERT STORM", 1300 coins, 30 days of PREMIUM account, 15000 bonus experience for your account, as well as bonus grenades, shmels, med kits, etc.

When purchasing an ELITE BATTLE PASS, you will immediately receive 1 exclusive skin for character and 1 exclusive weapon, as well as a +10% experience booster, which is credited to the progress of the ELITE BATTLE PASS;

Innovations:
[list]
[*] Season 3 - DESERT STORM has started in the game. The season will last until June 12 inclusive;
[*] Exclusive weapons with unique thematic skins (15 weapons), exclusive skins for a character (8 skins), exclusive skins for vehicles (5 skins) have been added to the game. These items cannot be bought in the store! The rewards received for completing Season 3 can be used on any servers. Abilities for new skins will be implemented soon;
[*] Added skins: HELICOPTER PILOT, OPPOSITION SOLDIER, REGULAR ARMY SOLDIER, PEACEMAKER, OFFICER, CAPTAIN, DELTA, VETERAN OF SPECIAL FORCES;
[*] Added weapons: AK47 DS, AKS-74U DS, M4A1 DS, M16A4 DS, M249 DS, PKP DS, ANACONDA DS, BERETTA DS, MAC10 DS, P90 DS, SCORPION EVO3 DS, SPAS12 DS, SAIGA12 DS, BARRETT M95 DS, SVD DS.
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Updated the background in the game menu, as well as the loading background.
[/list]

Corrections:
[list]
[*] Fixed a number of bugs related to anti-cheat.
[/list]

In the coming days, several more updates are expected with improvements to game mechanics and bug fixes.

Thank you all for your attention and good game!

notes.title: EasyAnticheat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/a30cc12ec8b95aee7d16a7ba22c079acdc5c44ff.png[/img]

Hello to the Blockade community!
 
At such a late hour, we hasten to please you with an important update for the game. Many of you have been asking for season 3 or "Tanks" mode. Someone wanted to update the "Build" mode, however... there is one problem in the game, without solving which we will not be able to properly complete everything planned. It's no secret that cheaters have periodically appeared in the game since the release. So far, we have dealt with them simply - we updated the protection and worked on updates for some time until the cheaters found new loopholes. However, this option no longer suits us, because cheaters constantly interfere with both you and us, which means that the problem needs to be solved in a different way. We cannot solve this problem on our own for a long time, and therefore, since the beginning of 2022, we have been implementing anti-cheat in the game client. We are glad to announce that from today the Blockade game will have an external anti-cheat, which, we hope, will allow us to implement our plans for this year. It took a lot of time to prepare the update. We had to rework and improve a lot. The introduction of anti-cheat in the game client led to a whole chain of various changes and edits. We are well aware that this technical update did not bring anything new to the game that would interest you. But even without this update, it would only be more difficult to work in the future.
 
Let's move on to the list of changes and innovations:
 
Innovations:
[list]
[*] Added external anti-cheat - EasyAnticheat;
[*] Added display for various game launch errors;
[*] Work has begun to improve the ban system, when it will become possible to block violators in the game for a short time.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Due to the introduction of EasyAnticheat into the game, support for 32-bit versions of the Windows(X86) operating system had to be abandoned. From now on, the game only works on 64-bit versions;
[*] Improved authorization system.
[/list]
Corrections:
[list]
[*] Fixed a number of technical errors.
[/list]

Thank you all for your attention and fair game to all!

notes.title: Update 30.10.2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/87f5a29fb32e8c2b0792e3d7e41c006799425451.png[/img]

Hello soldiers!

And here is the second part of the holiday update ([i]and not the last[/i])!

[b]On October 31[/b], [b]Easter eggs (pumpkins) and ghosts[/b] will spawn in the game. This year changes were made for Easter eggs and ghosts. The hunting season is open!

The ghosts are now weaker and can be killed not only with a [u]explosives[/u], but also with "[u]Cursed Bones[/u]" edition weapons. They spawn on the servers once an hour. For killing ghosts, players gain experience ([i]100 experience per ghost[/i]). For killing the Ghost Boss, the players are given a lot of experience ([i]who has killed earns 500 experience, and another 500 experience is divided into all others players in proportion to the damage done[/i])! For spawn ghosts on the server [u][b]must be at least 10 people[/b][/u].

Easter eggs will now spawn more often and according to the new system every 10 minutes with a certain chance ([i]15% chance for small and 5% for large[/i]). For spawns of small Easter eggs on the server there [u][b]must be at least 10 people[/b][/u], [u][b]and large ones - 12 people[/b][/u]. From small Easter eggs you can get [b]from 3 to 10 coins[/b], and after the spawn [u]they disappear after 15 seconds[/u]. Large Easter eggs do not disappear after the spawn, and the [b]reward of 250 coins is divided between the players in proportion to the damage done[/b]. That player, who will kill Large Easter egg will receive an additional bonus: 20 M61, 20 SMELs, 20 MK3, 20 M202 and 50 pumpkins on the head! All types of Easter eggs can be found in the modes of [b]Contra, Battle, Survival, Zombies, Domination[/b]. [u][b]It is useless to search for Easter eggs on private servers![/b][/u]

Innovations:
[list]
[*] Added easter eggs for which you can get coins and ammunition;
[*] Added ghosts for killing which you can gain experience;
[*] Added maps for the modes: Melee ([i]2 BRIDGES[/i]), Contra ([i]FAUBOURG, TURBINE, DOUBLECROSS, AZTECS[/i]).
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 05.09.2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/d657857ae478a53a9ddf8d8cbc17143d7a830954.png[/img]

Hello soldiers!

Summer ended and autumn came. Someone started studying, someone returned from vacation, and the next update came out in the Blockade Classic.
In this update, we have moved a bit away from plans to implement a system of reports about suspicious activity by players. This decision was made due to the fact that after the previous update, the possibility of using and developing cheats was minimized and the cheaters in the game were temporarily lost.
This respite allowed us to focus on other tasks of the project. Many of you have long asked for the opportunity to earn more coins than the daily and weekly bonus gives. But no sweet without some sweat. Therefore, we decided to take the next step in the development of the game - the launch of [b]daily and weekly tournaments[/b] among players.
These tournaments are automatic and are held without the participation of judges.
To become a participant in the tournament you need to buy a pass to the tournament, part of the cost of which goes to the formation of the prize pool.
Аdministration provides a starting prize fund for each tournament.
The more participants in the tournament - the greater the prize pool and the more prizes.
The minimum number of tournament participants is 10.
The minimum number of prizes is 5.
At the end of the tournament, provided there are not enough participants (less than 10 participants), the tournament is considered unsuccessful and a refund is made for the tournament.
Tournament winners are determined by the maximum amount of experience gained during the tournament.
Remember that with the [b]PREMIUM[/b], the earned experience doubles, as well as the chances of winning the tournament!
If you enter the tournament - [u]the number of coins that you can earn will depend on you![/u] [b]The more you play, the more chances you will increase your capital![/b]

[b]DAILY TOURNAMENT[/b]

[list]
[*] The tournament starts every day automatically at 00 hours 00 minutes GMT.
[*] The duration of the tournament is 24 hours.
[*] The starting prize pool of the tournament is 300 coins.
[*] The cost of a tournament pass is 2 coins, of which 1 coin is credited to the tournament prize pool.
[*] The number of prizes is 15% of the total number of participants.
[*] Reward for first place is 25% of the prize pool but not more than 300 coins.
[*] The remainder of the prize fund is distributed among the winners in proportion to the prize place.
[*] Tournament information is updated 1 time per minute.
[/list]

[b]WEEKLY TOURNAMENT[/b]

[list]
[*] The tournament starts every Thursday automatically at 00 hours 00 minutes GMT.
[*] The duration of the tournament is 7 days.
[*] The starting prize pool of the tournament is 1500 coins.
[*] The cost of a tournament pass is 10 coins, of which 7 coins are credited to the tournament prize pool.
[*] The number of prizes is 15% of the total number of participants.
[*] Reward for first place is 25% of the prize pool but not more than 1500 coins.
[*] The remainder of the prize fund is distributed among the winners in proportion to the prize place.
[*] Tournament information is updated 1 time per minute.
[/list]

[u]Valid restrictions:[/u]
[list]
[*] To enroll experience in tournament statistics, you must play on servers with at least 16 players present.
[*] if a player violates the rules of the game (see the RULES section in the main menu of the game), his achievements in the tournament can be canceled, and the funds spent on the purchase of a pass to the tournament will not be refundable.
[/list]

*By purchasing a pass to the tournament, you agree to the above conditions of the tournament and acknowledge that if you fail to win a prize, you will lose coins spent on the purchase of a pass.

*[i][b]beta[/b][/i] - tournaments are launched in beta testing mode. Tournament terms, restrictions, and tournament rewards may change over time.

In addition to tournaments, there are other changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Added a description of all items in the main menu of the game and when choosing weapons in the game.
[*] Added the correct names of items in the main menu of the game and when choosing weapons in the game.
[*] Added an indicator of the amount of purchased ammunition for 1 purchase.
[*] Changed game bonus notification system.
[*] Added display of received rewards in daily bonus.
[*] Optimized updating the list of servers in the main menu of the game.
[*] Optimized the system of buying items in the game.
[*] Fixed access to Scorpion weapon in the presence of a megapack.
[*] Fixed display of the number of ammunition when choosing weapons in the game.
[/list]

We hope this update brings a new meaning to the game for some of you. And we will continue to work on the development of the project and bring something new to it.

Good game to all!

notes.title: Update 05.07.19
Great Victory Day!
HAPPY BIRTHDAY, BLOCKADE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/fe26a6cc64d0bdb9d1c2d38dcd4cb089593647bc.png[/img]

Hello, soldiers!

Some of you know that [u]exactly 6 years ago[/u] on this day, a game called [b]Blockade 3D[/b] was released. On behalf of the developers and the administration of the project, we want to congratulate our players and fans on the main holiday for the game!

During these 6 years a lot of interesting things happened in the game. During this time, menus and animations, sounds, modes and maps changed ... New weapons were added and various events were held.

Many players during this time have already managed to forget, and some may not even know what that Blockade looked like from which it all began. We want to please you with the good news that today a new mode has been added to the game - a variant of the very classic “Battle” mode, from which everything started 6 years ago, which is symbolically called “[b]Alpha[/b]”. We tried to recreate the atmosphere of the game of that time.

[list]
[*] In honor of the Blockade's Birthday, the "[b]Alpha[/b]" mode was launched, almost completely repeating the same "Battle" mode at the start of the project in 2013;
[*] For the "Alpha" mode, the classic versions of the maps of the "Battle" mode for 2013 were added without any changes;
[*] [u]All players are given gifts[/u].
[*] The game has launched a special offer to buy coins.
[/list]

We thank everyone for being active. Good game!

Good game!

notes.title: Update 25.04.19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png[/img]

Hello, soldiers!

As we promised earlier, a new update has been added to the game. In this update, all changes were made taking into account the wishes and feedback of our players. We want to warn that all these changes [u][b]are not final[/b][/u]. We will monitor the situation in the game and your feedback in order to understand whether we are moving in the right direction. [u]You have a real opportunity to influence the balancing of objects in the game[/u]. [b]The prices for weapons are set taking into account all balance edits and are subject to change later.[/b]

[list]
[*] Completely redesigned balance of weapons in the game.
[*] Changed the price of weapons with the new balance.
[*] Changed the distribution of weapons by level.
[*] Changed server sorting.
[*] Unavailable servers are now displayed in the servers list.
[/list]

All this is only the first stage of the upcoming changes in the game. All game items will be affected. [u]Your feedback is very important to us in this matter.[/u] [b]We want to make the game comfortable for our players![/b]

Good game!

notes.title: Update 20.04.19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png[/img]

Hello, soldiers!

New update came out!
[list]
[*] Launched [b]European[/b] servers located in [b]Germany[/b].

Running a bit into the future, we want to announce a [b]rebalance of weapons[/b], which will be implemented [u]in the next update[/u] in the middle of next week. notes.title: Update 12.04.19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png[/img]

Hello, fighters!

First of all, we want to congratulate you on the International Day of Human Space Flight! May all your undertakings reach the same heights as Yuri Gagarin once reached!

In honor of this momentous day in the game starts the action on the purchase of in-game currency, which will last until the end of next week. The description and conditions of the action can be found in the main menu in the coin replenishment section.

Innovations:
[list]
[*] The discount system when buying coins is added to the game. It is calculated depending on the amount of previously purchased coins and works for purchases of 100 coins or more (including action offers). [u][b]The discount increases with every purchase.[/b][/u]
[*] The ability to view your transaction history has been added to the coin replenishment section. Now, if coins didn’t come to you when buying them, you need to open the [b]HISTORY[/b] tab in the coins replenishment section, find the pending transaction ([u]marked in red[/u]) and click the [b]UPDATE[/b] button. [u]If the transaction was previously confirmed by you - the coins will be issued to you [b]automatically[/b].[/u]
[*] Changed the player's nickname change algorithm - now when you try to use non-printable characters in the nickname, they will be ignored. If the nickname consists entirely of non-printable characters, it will automatically be replaced by the [b]Player+SteamID64[/b]. Also, this algorithm automatically processes the player's nickname when entering the game and when connecting to the game server. [u]If you notice that your nickname has changed when entering the game or on the server, [b]please use the printable characters the next time you change your nickname[/b].[/u]
[/list]

We are continuing to fix bugs and errors in the game and want to thank everyone for their active participation in this!

Thank you for your attention and good game!

[*] Fixed bug with inability to connect to the server.

notes.title: Update 06.04.19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png[/img]

Hi, Fighters!

We are glad to announce the first large-scale update in the game! This update brings to the game several significant innovations and the correction of many errors.

[b]Innovations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Servers are divided into 2 types - for players [u]up to level 5 inclusive[/u] and for all others. Now you can see the list of servers according to your level. This is done by the numerous requests of the community and will allow new players to "painlessly" join the game, deal with game mechanics, acquire the initial "skill" and generally understand and feel the game.
[u][b]Attention![/b] Weapons that do not match the server level will not be available in inventory![/u]
[*] Added the ability to play with friends. Now in the main menu in the "GAME" section added the tab "WITH A FRIEND". It contains a list of servers on which your friends are currently playing. At the moment you can simply connect to the server your friend is playing on. In the future, we will improve this mechanics for more detailed interaction with friends.
[/list]

[b]Corrections:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a weapon that fell out of the hands when dying - now the falling out weapon corresponds to what was in the hands.
[*] Fixed changing the player's skin when changing map on the server.
[*] Fixed localization of the drawing range options in the OPTIONS menu.
[*] Fixed automatic reloading of the Crossbow after the shot.
[/list]
As well as many minor fixes and improvements.

[u][b]ATTENTION![/b] If you do not observe the changes described above, or have problems with access to servers or displaying menu items - you need to check the relevance of your version of the game client. If necessary, it should be updated manually through the "Check the integrity of the game files."[/u]

Good luck on the battlefield!
